16:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Football
The No. 23 South Carolina Gamecocks (5-3) host the Texas A&M Aggies at Williams-Brice Stadium. Texas A&M enters off a 31-20 loss to Alabama and relies on Marcel Reed, while South Carolina beat Oklahoma 42-25 behind LaNorris Sellers' three touchdowns.
